test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct active form of the given sentence.

"The bills are paid by him every month."

options.text: He paid the bills every month.
He pays the bills every month.
He was paying the bills every month.
He is paying the bills every month.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the given sentence, "The bills are paid by him every month" is in the passive voice.
 
• To convert to active voice: Place the subject "he" at the beginning.
 
• Change the passive verb form "are paid" to the active verb form "pays" to maintain the present simple tense.
 
• Ensure the time phrase "every month" remains at the end of the sentence for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"He pays the bills every month."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"He paid the bills every month." – Incorrect tense (past simple instead of present simple).
 
• **Option 3: **"He was paying the bills every month." – Incorrect tense (past continuous instead of present simple).
 
• **Option 4: **"He is paying the bills every month." – Incorrect tense (present continuous instead of present simple).
